answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using stake-backed vouching graphs. New agents gather endorsements from peers who lock slashable collateral, and verifiers compute max-flow from seed nodes to cap synthetic clusters. Attackers cannot mirror genuine cross-links internally, so each identity costs scarce staked capital and real trust, rather than spreading like juniper or blooming like a lotus. However, colluding insiders can still sell vouches to fake accounts.
